rows.en:
No. 8001… Your mission was to get close to Goro Watari and report where he was hiding…

And then to attack Goro Watari! Why do you defy my orders? Why have you shamelessly come crawling back here?
What was that missile attack supposed to mean?
The operation was changed at short notice!
You meant to kill me too, didn't you?
You are my hound. All you need do is obey your master's orders.
Go! Like the hound you are, go and sink your teeth into Goro Watari!
Mr. Arai, that wound!? Are you all right?

Yeah, don't worry about it…

But…

That girl might contact Udesper again… Even though they nearly killed her too. Poor thing.
So you knew after all? …She's a cyborg built for evil!
Cyborg or not, she's human! She must have a human heart.
The one we should hate… is Udesper, the one pulling her strings!
A cyborg… A machine that just moves as it's ordered? No, that's not it…
I am Udesper's hound…
You…!?
Ugh…
Mr. Arai!?
You're a cyborg, aren't you?
A cyborg? Mr. Arai is!?
Those symptoms of Mr. Arai's… His Diode VS3 has been destroyed.
Diode VS3? What do we have to do to get one?

That part is made at the same time a human is turned into a cyborg.

I doubt even the Desper base has any in stock…
Then… Mr. Arai is just going to stay like this!?
If we wire him directly into his power circuit… he can survive for 24 hours.
24 hours!? That's all?
It's because I'm a cyborg that I can survive for a whole 24 hours! Isn't that right?
Why did you join the Desper Army? Why do you let them order you around?
Do you have some goal?

I… I wanted to get the Desper Army's secrets to [VAR6]…

To earn the Desper Army's trust, I had no choice but to become a cyborg, as Udesper's hound.

So that's how it was!?

Please! Wire me directly into the power circuit!
There's no need for that. Diode VS3… Please use this.
Where did you get this!? Didn't you just say there weren't any in stock…?

…………

I'm Udesper's hound. Something like this is nothing…
Look out!!
Aaaaaah!!

…………

Ugh… This is… fine… Either way… my life… only had 24… hours…
Hang in there!! Hey, stay with me!!
24 hours… What does she mean? Hang in there!
Damn it, you'd even kill your own subordinate!?
Those who cannot fight have no right to live! That is the law of the Desper Army!
Mr. Arai, this is bad! That Diode VS3…
That Diode VS3… it's hers!

When she saw you wounded in the battle, Mr. Arai, she took that part out of her own body!

She asked us not to tell you… but…!
Then… Th-this is hers!? She gave me her own life!?
Udesper, you're the one I will never forgive!! Even cyborgs have lives!
Spare me!! Goro Watari!! Today is our final showdown!
Goriki Shorai!
Sanagiman! Hurry up and become [VAR6]!
Choriki Shorai!

[VAR6]… You're strong after all!

But… even if I, Udesper, die… I will return without fail!

Udesper is the pride of our Desper Army! That is why Udesper will not die!

Udesper… I shall grant you your hour of vengeance. Be reborn as Udesper Alpha and Udesper Beta…

And fight! Until you have defeated [VAR6] and we have built our empire…
The formidable Udesper had fallen… But from his remains, Fuhrer Geisel brought forth two devils: Udesper Alpha and Udesper Beta.
Don't lose to the Desper Army and its iron discipline, Goro Watari! Fight on, our [VAR6]!
Goro!!
Mr. Arai!!
Mr. Arai!!
Mr. Arai!!
Defeat all Desper Soldiers!
Defeat Udesper and all Desper Soldiers!
Goro Watari or Makoto Arai is defeated

Cap! An emergency order from Paris HQ. I'll read it…

"A group of flying objects, apparently saucers, has been confirmed entering Earth's space at 0:24 Greenwich Mean Time! All branches are to tighten their defenses…

However… the purpose of the saucer fleet remains unknown. Therefore, they are not to be attacked rashly!"

End of message!

0:24 Greenwich… that's 9:24 in Japan… We've only got 40 minutes!

Fuji! Send a request to the Special Forces Unit and the Security Unit to tighten our air defenses!
Arashi! Have the National Police Agency issue an alert to every prefectural police headquarters!
Yes, sir!
I believe their targets are Earth's two great powers…
You're saying it's an invasion?

No doubt about it…

Flying saucers have appeared on Earth frequently since 1930. They were coming to scout us…

But this time… judging by the scale alone, this is no mere reconnaissance.
An all-out attack on Earth…
The enemy has been waiting 70 years for this chance.
Come on, then! Bring on whatever you've got, arrows or guns!

Ide! Watch your mouth! This could be Earth's last day!

Look! The saucers will enter the atmosphere in 5 minutes!
This is the Special Forces Unit… Current position… latitude 28°30' north, longitude 155°20' east!
That's 500 km northeast of Hawaii, right? Can you acquire the targets from there?
No… We can't see anything yet!

I see…

And they still haven't turned up on radar anywhere?
Not yet…

Cap! Let's fire missiles at them!

Strike first and win! This is no time to sit on our hands and watch!
I agree with Arashi! Whichever country they're aiming for, in the end… it'll mean defeat for the whole Earth!
Let's sortie!

uncertain: Arai-san rendered "Mr. Arai" (Goro and the heroes address a senior); bare "Arai" would sound rude.
U06303: 余計なことだ read as Udesper brushing off Goro's outburst ("Spare me!!").
U06318: the quoted order put in "double quotes" for readability; no 『』 in the source.
U06319: 特殊部隊班 rendered "Special Forces Unit" (Sawa's group, see U06329); 警備班 "Security Unit".
U06322: 二大国 rendered "two great powers"; the source does not name them.
Speaker placeholders [HERO2]/[HERO4]/[VAR6] have speaker_en null; these are game-inserted names, not new names.

new_names.why: not in glossary (only デスパー兵士 etc.)
